negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, issuer-specific GENIUS application or registered foreign exception was located for Old Vector LLC or A7A5 in the checked public sources as of 2026-10-07. The OCC charter-application table is not an exhaustive GENIUS register. The issuer agreement identifies Kyrgyz public-offering registration and excludes U.S.-connected users. Treasury explicitly identifies A7A5 as blocked property; this is independent OFAC prohibition, not a GENIUS authorization revocation.

genius.notes: Old Vector LLC is preserved as the issuer. Treasury explicitly calls A7A5 a blocked token on October 1, 2026, following the August 14, 2025 issuer designation. enforcementStatus and daspOfferSaleStatus reflect the independent U.S. sanctions prohibition, subject to OFAC authorization or exemption; no GENIUS revocation is claimed. The Act remains pre-effective in the checked implementation materials; the expected January 18, 2027 issuer/foreign-lawful-order timing and July 18, 2028 general DASP licensing restriction do not override sanctions. The issuer FAQ describes daily bank-interest distributions, which are not evidence of GENIUS compliance. Foreign-exception status remains unknown because no registration or qualification evidence was located.
